description: Read an existing generate_code JSON payload from a local file and run the same generation flow. Use generate_from_recipe for compact field maps and reusable JSON templates. outputPath, skipExisting, and dryRun arguments override values in the file.

dryRun.description: Preview mode - returns generated code without writing files. Overrides dryRun in spec file if provided.

outputPath.description: Output directory path where files will be written. Overrides outputPath in spec file if provided.

skipExisting.description: Skip writing files that already exist. Overrides skipExisting in spec file if provided.

specFilePath.description: Path to the JSON spec file (absolute or relative to current directory)

name: load_spec_from_file
title: Load Code Spec from File
